bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: ADA standards set a maximum wheelchair ramp slope of 1-to-12 (1 inch rise per 12 inches run) with 36-inch clear width.
core_mechanism_bullets: ADA standards set a maximum wheelchair ramp slope of 1-to-12 (1 inch rise per 12 inches run) with 36-inch clear width.
Accessible doorways require at least 32 inches clear width, lever hardware 34 to 48 inches high, and a 60-inch turn circle.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: A porch entry sitting 24 inches above grade requires an ADA ramp at least 24 feet long with level 60-by-60-inch landings at top and bottom.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Use a tape measure and digital level on the meeting room doorway and ramp to verify the 32-inch clear door width and 1-to-12 (4.8-degree) maximum ramp slope.

Accessible restrooms require grab bars 33 to 36 inches high, insulated sink pipes, and dispensers within a 48-inch reach.
